item.title: Entrepreneurship: Shaping the Future
item.content:encoded:
Diego Matricano, University of Campania "Luigi Vanvitelli"

This multi-journal collection, guest-edited by Diego Matricano, brings together research from three participating journals focused on entrepreneurship as a mechanism for addressing major global challenges. The collection emphasizes understanding both the anticipated and actual impacts of entrepreneurship, as well as their broader implications for society.

The collection welcomes papers that examine how entrepreneurship shapes the future by analyzing the phenomenon at multiple levels—from individual and organizational perspectives to industry and national scales. Research should investigate the concrete effects of entrepreneurial activities and their potential to drive meaningful change in response to global issues.

Appel publié par International Entrepreneurship and Management Journal. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Impact of entrepreneurship on addressing global issues
  • Expected and realized changes related to entrepreneurship phenomena
  • Implications of entrepreneurship phenomena
  • Micro, meso, and macro levels of analysis in entrepreneurship
  • Internationalization and entrepreneurship
  • Entrepreneurship in diverse organizational contexts
  • Global entrepreneurship research
